links.comparator_used: Simultaneous presentation of all 77 questions in a single prompt versus sequential delivery in batches of ten, across six LLMs
links.outcome: Accuracy, inter-model variability and reproducibility on pediatric residency-level MCQs
links.effect: Simultaneous delivery: accuracy 38%-90% with significant inter-model differences. Batches of ten: accuracy 83%-88% with no statistically significant inter-model differences.
links.quote: In contrast, batch delivery resulted in marked convergence of performance across models (83%-88%), with no statistically significant inter-model differences.

design_hint: structured batch delivery of prompts (reducing input context load)
